path_traversal_relevant_observations: No base-directory containment check, no '..' rejection, no canonicalization (realpath/normpath) anywhere on the package-name-derived paths before open/shutil.unpack_archive

package_name flows from CLI 'identifier' or requirements.txt content into os.path.join(directory, package_name + file_extension); mixed separators or '..' segments are not stripped (is_local_package only routes local vs remote)
download URL is taken from PyPI release metadata (file['url']) and the archive bytes are then extracted with shutil.unpack_archive without entry-name validation in this code version
unzippedpath is derived by string removesuffix, not by path normalization
coverage_gaps: Dynamic receiver: .extractall is invoked on the result of the call tarsafe.open(path); moduleHint cannot be resolved to a dotted import path and is emitted as <dynamic>.extractall with the receiver call text

Dictionary-key flows (data['releases'], file['filename'], file['url'], data['info']['version']) are not modeled at call granularity by the extraction queries; the source rows stop at requests.get / .json() returns

resp.content.decode().splitlines() (project_scanner.py:270) - requirements lines from the remote response are captured indirectly via the scan_requirements(requirements) parameter row, not as a call-level source row
invoke_semgrep is a third-party semgrep-internal API; argument semantics (arg 1 = target path list) were inferred from call sites in analyzer.py

Dotted moduleHint values are syntactic (textual) resolutions of the callee expression, not resolved API models; alias imports would not be distinguished (current imports are direct: import os, shutil, tarsafe, tempfile, requests, click)
Keyword-only/defaulted parameters of click handlers (rules, exclude_rules, json flags) are included as candidate rows for completeness; they are not path inputs and are expected to be labeled 'none'

extraction_query_contract.execution: codeql query run <query> --database <DB> --output <bqrs>, then codeql bqrs decode <bqrs> --format=csv --output <csv> (NOT database analyze / SARIF)
extraction_query_contract.kind: plain multi-column select queries; intentionally no @kind problem annotation and no @kind table assumption
columns: node - candidate AST node descriptor (Call:<callee> / Parameter:<name>)
moduleHint - syntactic dotted callee path (e.g. os.path.join) or '<dynamic>.<name>'
argIndex - argument index; parameter rows use the declared positional index (methods include 'self' at index 0); -1 when not applicable
context - family/context explanation for the labeling step
ql_safety_rules_applied: no AstNode.getFile(); locationStr uses getLocation().getFile()/getStartLine() verified against python-all 7.1.2
no QL classes with unbound this or invalid supertypes; only predicates and string functions
no {{...}} template placeholders remain; queries are rendered concrete
API::Node / DataFlow::Node conversions not needed (pure AST extraction, no dataflow in these queries)
